meta.title: A line's quantity keeps its unit whether the PR sends a number or a quantity object
gaps: The setup provides one line item, not two PR items with quantities 100 KG and 50 NOS.
The available read-back fields do not expose line quantity or display unit, so preservation of quantity units cannot be asserted.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: As the buyer, list the event's line items and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
